question: Sangeet Natak Akademi award winner Guru Bipin Singh is a famous _________ dancer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipuri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Guru Bipin Singh was a renowned classical dancer and choreographer of the **Manipuri dance form**.

• He was awarded the prestigious **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** for his contributions to Manipuri dance.

• Manipuri dance, also known as Jagoi, is one of the major Indian classical dance forms, originating from the northeastern state of Manipur.

• Guru Bipin Singh played a crucial role in popularizing Manipuri dance and taking it to the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Manipuri Dance**

• Manipuri dance is one of the six classical dance styles of India.

• It is particularly known for its themes based on the Vaishnavism tradition and the love story of Radha and Krishna.

• The dance is characterized by graceful, fluid movements and is often performed as a group dance.

• The traditional costumes used in Manipuri dance are elaborate and colorful, often including a distinctive cylindrical skirt called the 'Patloi'.

• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**

• The Sangeet Natak Akademi Award is a national honor bestowed by India's National Academy of Music, Dance & Drama.

• It is the highest recognition given to practicing artists, performers, and teachers for their outstanding contribution to the fields of music, dance, and drama.

• The award includes a citation, a plaque, and a cash prize.

• It was instituted in 1952 and has been awarded annually to artists from various disciplines.

• **Other Indian Classical Dance Forms**

• **Bharatanatyam** - Originating from Tamil Nadu, it is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork combined with expressive hand gestures.

• **Kathak** - A classical dance form from Northern India, known for its intricate footwork, spins, and expressive storytelling.

• **Kathakali** - A dance-drama from Kerala, characterized by elaborate costumes, makeup, and face masks.

• **Kuchipudi** - Originating from Andhra Pradesh, it is known for its fast rhythms and fluid movements, often incorporating speech into the dance.

• **Odissi** - From Odisha, this dance form is known for its tribhangi posture and intricate hand movements.

• **Mohiniattam** - A graceful dance form from Kerala, performed by women with slow, swaying movements.
